purpose: Interface for the post-dispatch observation hook invoked by every V2 dispatcher after _dispatch completes. Defines the single onDispatch(minter, amount, extraData) method called with the same tuple passed to ATokenDispatcherV2.dispatch.

externalEntryPoints.function: onDispatch(address minter, uint256 amount, bytes calldata extraData)
externalEntryPoints.notes: Contract: implementations must not rely on dispatcher storage and must tolerate arbitrary extraData. A reverting hook reverts the enclosing dispatch (and thus the mint).

invariants: Hook is always invoked with the identical (minter, amount, extraData) the dispatcher received.
A reverting onDispatch reverts the enclosing dispatch — implementers must be robust.
trustAssumptions: Implementations are owner-set and therefore trusted; the interface places the hook inside the dispatch trust boundary.
